source_refs.title: Create & manage labels in Gmail - Computer - Gmail Help
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer, in Gmail: 1. Open Gmail on your computer. 2. In the left sidebar, next to 'Labels', click the 'Create new label' icon. 3. Enter a name for the label. 4. Optional: To nest it under another label, check 'Nest label under' and choose the parent label. 5. Click 'Create'.

source_refs.section: Apply a label to an existing email
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer, in Gmail: 1. Check the box next to the email. 2. At the top, click the 'Labels' icon. 3. Uncheck the current label. 4. Select the new label.
